test_metadata_load: test the metadata_load function to parse YAML frontmatter from a model card file
test_metadata_save: test the metadata_save function to write metadata dict into YAML frontmatter of a card file
test_metadata_update: test the metadata_update function to update model card metadata on a Hugging Face Hub repo
test_repo_card_load: test the RepoCard class to load and parse a repository card from a local file or Hub
test_model_card_template: test the ModelCard class to create a model card from a Jinja2 template with card data
test_dataset_card_template: test the DatasetCard class to create a dataset card from a Jinja2 template with card data
test_space_card_load: test the SpaceCard class to load a space card from the Hugging Face Hub
test_push_to_hub: test the RepoCard.push_to_hub method to push a model card to a Hugging Face Hub repository
